decisions.reason: As a distant diversification that was only briefly mentioned and then disappeared, it likely stayed below aspiration levels and no longer justifies tying up resources outside the core lighting business.
A launch-year standalone page followed by immediate disappearance signals performance below aspiration, so management would reallocate resources from this related but unsuccessful product.
This product stayed visible across multiple years and even received a follow-on LED replacement kit, indicating satisfactory results or strategic promise in a core industrial segment.
Although initially supported as a relaunched popular item, its later disappearance suggests it did not sustain results at the level expected for a mature, close-to-core offering.
Despite fitting the core office-lighting business, its visibility only at launch points to underperformance relative to high aspirations in a growing and competitive professional LED market.

This close-to-core premium pendant line appears not to have earned continued attention after launch, so a boundedly rational management would prune it and use the capacity for stronger core products or new development.
